items.title: Elastic spring-energy model and constrained minimization
items.disposition: Torsional hinges, in-plane stretching surrogate, face-bending/contact/strain constraints and periodic boundaries. Numerical ±0.30 strain and ±0.985π hinge limits are not measured physical safety limits.

items.title: Numerical compression comparison
items.source_locator: Main Fig2b and Methods Compression test; SI1
items.disposition: κ=10^-4, 1000 loading increments plus 1000 unloading increments, Active-set; SI1 stiffness comparisons. Not physical cycles, rate or additional specimens.

items.title: Sequential hinge-pair landscapes and release search
items.disposition: Loading order, projected energy maps and numerical relaxation/clustering. Triangular prism differs from truncated tetrahedron; no physical robot action raster is recovered.

items.title: Symmetry reduction and discrete hinge combinations
items.source_locator: Main Reducing search space and Hinge selection reduction; SI4, SI9
items.disposition: Directed-graph search, binary hinge selections and symmetry comparison; source formula conflicts preserved, no new optimizer implemented.

items.title: Unique-state clustering and stability sweeps
items.disposition: Computational search counts, κ_max sweeps and further 16 structures; larger hinge counts restrict search to up to three hinges; not exhaustive physical state counts.

items.title: Periodic metamaterial search
items.disposition: 11 polyhedra yielding 15 material tessellations, 11 with additional states in restricted periodic search. Finite boundary/long-period observations have different domains.

items.title: Prospective scale and application discussion
items.disposition: Microscale fabrication, capillarity, alternative stimuli and acoustic/MEMS/energy-storage applications are outlook, not demonstrated physical branches.

rule: Numerical inputs/results may be supplied as labeled reference artifacts for comparison, never counted as additional physical experiments or physical station settings. No solver or physical simulation is run.
